SELECT p.partsID, p.partsName, p.partsCode, p.partsType, p.retailPr, p.adaptedVehicle, p.enterpriseID, e.enterpriseName, (SELECT imageSrc FROM parts_image WHERE partsID = p.partsID LIMIT 1) as imageSrc FROM parts p LEFT JOIN enterprise e ON p.enterpriseID = e.enterpriseID ORDER BY LENGTH(p.partsID) DESC, p.partsID DESC
